text_block_list.text:
"Huge hit on social media! Featured 
special: CICA extract ampoules for 
ultra-hydrated, silky-smooth skin!" 
...Hrmmm~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
CICA...? Ampoule... booster? Hmph, so this 
"City girl" has these magic spells down 
pat, huh? A-Alright then...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Smartphone-san, I'm counting on ya! Please 
help me out with that search function of 
yours~...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
..."A booster refers to a prepping essence 
serum." ...What in the world is a prepping 
essence...?
